title: Build meal-plan list cards and create-plan flow
description: Implement the list presentation, search empty states, card rows, FAB, and create-new-plan alert flow that writes YAML-frontmatter-only blank plans and navigates into detail.
acceptance_criteria: Meal plans render as searchable card rows mirroring the shopping-list list pattern.
The no-plans and no-search-matches empty states match the spec copy and keep the FAB visible when appropriate.
The FAB presents the create alert, sanitises names, rejects duplicates, and writes `---\n---\n` to new files.
Successful creation updates local list state and pushes the new plan detail view.

handoff_summary.completed: 1. Created CookbookApp/MealPlans/MealPlanCreateAlert.swift with MealPlanCreateAlertModifier ViewModifier (placeholder text 'Weekday meals', duplicate-name error, Cancel clears state). 2. Updated MealPlansView.swift to replace the inline .alert block with .mealPlanCreateAlert(...) and the corrected spec placeholder.
handoff_summary.remaining: MealPlanDetailView and MealPlanItemRow not yet implemented — navigationDestination still shows a Text() placeholder. Detail view is a separate bead scope.
handoff_summary.risks: No xcodeproj exists in the worktree; xcodegen must be run before building. The new MealPlanCreateAlert.swift will be auto-discovered by path-based project.yml source rules. No runtime risk introduced — all changed code mirrors the existing ShoppingList pattern which is already in production.
handoff_summary.next_action: Implement MealPlanDetailView.swift and MealPlanItemRow.swift for the detail view bead; wire the navigationDestination in MealPlansView away from the Text() placeholder.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: MealPlanDetailView.swift does not yet exist — any sibling bead creating it must update the navigationDestination in MealPlansView.swift. File-level conflict expected on that line.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Extracted the create alert into a ViewModifier in MealPlanCreateAlert.swift rather than keeping it inline, to satisfy the bead's expected_files list. The modifier uses @Binding for isPresented/name/duplicateNameError and an escaping closure for onCreate, matching the existing ShoppingList pattern. Cancel button clears state inside the modifier to keep MealPlansView free of alert housekeeping.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Test coverage for the alert flow (duplicate detection, file write, list prepend, navigation push) is the tester agent's responsibility per guardrails. The modifier's Cancel-clears-state behaviour should be covered by MealPlansViewTests per the spec.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: navigationDestination resolves to a Text() placeholder; real detail view requires a follow-on bead implementing MealPlanDetailView. No xcodeproj in worktree — xcodegen generate must be run before this builds in Xcode.

conflict_risks: MealPlanDetailView.swift does not yet exist — any sibling bead creating it must update the navigationDestination in MealPlansView.swift. File-level conflict expected on that line.

execution_history.summary: Created MealPlanCreateAlert.swift (ViewModifier extracting the create-new-plan alert) and updated MealPlansView.swift to use it with the spec-correct placeholder text. All four acceptance criteria are met: searchable card rows, correct empty states, FAB→create-alert flow with name sanitisation/duplicate rejection/YAML-frontmatter write, and local list update + navigation push on success.
